item.text: I have the core 2024 material already. I’m doing one last narrow search for any direct evidence of personnel replacement or method changes, because that is the specific hinge of this lens.

item.text:
**8B.8**

Bottom line: mostly no. There is some evidence of tactical adaptation, but I did not find strong evidence that Khamenei systematically replaced ineffective implementers, reallocated resources, or corrected course in a durable way in 2024. The pattern is closer to narrow damage control plus continued reliance on loyalist or coercive structures.

**Positive / Partial**
- [Tehran signals no retaliation against Israel after drones attack](https://www.theprint.in/world/tehran-signals-no-retaliation-against-israel-after-drones-attack/2048236/) | Reuters / ThePrint | 2024-04-19 | Claim: after the Isfahan incident, Tehran publicly chose no retaliation. That is a real tactical correction toward de-escalation, but it was short-lived. IDs: `8B.8`, `8B.3`, `8B.2`
- [Pezeshkian Cabinet Profiles](https://iranprimer.usip.org/index.php/blog/2024/aug/22/pezeshkian-cabinet-profiles) | The Iran Primer / USIP | 2024-08-22 | Claim: Pezeshkian’s cabinet was more diverse than Raisi’s and included reformists, technocrats, and academics, with Khamenei, the IRGC, and security agencies approving the list before submission. This is the best weak signal of personnel adjustment, but it looks like compromise inside a controlled system rather than a real correction mechanism. IDs: `8B.8`, `8B.5`, `8B.4`, `7B.5`, `7B.9`
- [Iran will not impede IAEA access, head of its atomic organisation says](https://theprint.in/world/iran-will-not-impede-iaea-access-head-of-its-atomic-organisation-says/2403254/) | Reuters / ThePrint | 2024-12-14 | Claim: Iran said it would not obstruct IAEA access and would work within safeguards. That is a narrow late-year procedural adjustment, but it is limited to the nuclear file. IDs: `8B.8`, `8B.6`, `7B.6`
- [Iran accepts not to produce uranium close to military use but West demands more cooperation](https://es.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/iran-acepta-no-producir-uranio-cercano-al-uso-militar-pero-occidente-exige-mas-cooperacion-2921557) | Reuters / Investing.com | 2024-11-20 | Claim: Iran took initial technical steps toward capping near-weapons-grade uranium. This is the strongest concrete adaptation signal, but it was conditional and fragile. IDs: `8B.8`, `8B.6`, `7B.6`

**Negative / Limits**
- [IAEA board passes resolution against Iran on cooperation, inspectors](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaea-board-passes-resolution-against-iran-on-cooperation-inspectors-3472087) | Reuters / Investing.com | 2024-06-05 | Claim: Iran had barred experienced inspectors and the IAEA board demanded reversal. This is direct evidence that prior tactics failed to produce durable correction in the nuclear file. IDs: `8B.8`, `8B.6`, `7B.6`
- [Iran holds presidential vote with limited choices](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iran-holds-presidential-vote-with-limited-choices-3500514) | Reuters / Investing.com | 2024-06-27 | Claim: candidates acknowledged economic crisis but avoided concrete plans. That suggests slogans remained ahead of corrective policy redesign, not that failed tactics triggered a serious economic reset. IDs: `8B.8`, `8B.2`, `8B.1`
- [Iran’s water crisis leads to alarming ground collapse](https://amp.dw.com/en/irans-water-crisis-leads-to-alarming-ground-collapse/a-69405927) | DW | 2024-06-19 | Claim: drought, water shortages, and land subsidence hit Tehran and hundreds of towns, affecting a large share of society. This is strong evidence against effective correction across ministries and regions. IDs: `8B.8`, `8B.5`, `8B.2`
- [Iran new compulsory veiling law intensifies oppression of women and girls](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/12/iran-new-compulsory-veiling-law-intensifies-oppression-of-women-and-girls/) | Amnesty International | 2024-12-10 | Claim: instead of relaxing enforcement after backlash, the system expanded coercive powers for police, intelligence, IRGC, and Basij. That is escalation, not course correction. IDs: `8B.8`, `8B.5`, `8B.4`, `7B.7`, `7B.9`
- [Iran draconian campaign to enforce compulsory veiling laws through surveillance and mass car confiscations](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/03/iran-draconian-campaign-to-enforce-compulsory-veiling-laws-through-surveillance-and-mass-car-confiscations/) | Amnesty International | 2024-03-06 | Claim: multiple state bodies coordinated a surveillance-and-punishment campaign against women defying hijab rules. This shows disciplined follow-through for repression, but not adaptive correction when the tactic was damaging or unpopular. IDs: `8B.8`, `8B.5`, `8B.4`, `7B.7`

**Search Gap**
- I did not find direct 2024 evidence that Khamenei personally fired ineffective implementers, shifted budgets, or issued a visible corrective reorganization after failure. The available evidence is mostly indirect and sector-specific, and the strongest positive items are narrow, tactical, and late.
